# gyro_domain_record (Resource)

A DNS record of a domain registered at Gyro (DNS management add-on required). Any change replaces the record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_domain_record" "www" {
  domain = "example.com"
  type   = "A"
  name   = "www"
  value  = gyro_server.web.ipv4
  ttl    = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)

### Optional

- `priority` (Number)
- `ttl` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `identity` (String) Provider record id (may be empty).
